items.a: Leave policy (edit to match your company): 12 casual / sick leaves and 12 to 18 earned (privilege) leaves per year, plus around 10 public holidays as per the company holiday list. Earned leave is credited monthly and can be carried forward up to a limit. Leaves must be applied in advance through the HR system and approved by the reporting manager. Maternity leave is 26 weeks as per law.

items.q: How do I apply for leave?
items.a: Apply for leave in the HR system / attendance app (or by email to your manager with HR in CC) at least 2 to 3 days in advance for planned leave. For sudden sick leave, inform your manager by call or message before shift start and apply in the system the same day. Leave of more than 2 days of sickness may need a medical certificate.

items.a: Attendance policy (edit to match your company): office hours are 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday to Friday (or Saturday as applicable), with a 1-hour lunch break. Mark attendance daily in the system. A grace time of 15 minutes is allowed up to 3 times a month; after that, late marks may lead to a half-day deduction. Work-from-home needs manager approval.

Salary is usually credited by the last working day of the month or by the 7th of the next month (edit to match your company). Payslips are available in the HR / payroll portal. For any salary query, email HR / payroll with your employee ID and month.
Payslips can be downloaded from the HR / payroll portal under the Payslips section. If you cannot access it, email HR with your employee ID and the months you need.

items.q: How to check my PF balance and UAN?
items.a: Your UAN (Universal Account Number) is on your payslip or available from HR. Check your PF balance on the EPFO member portal (unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in), the UMANG app, or by SMS / missed call to EPFO's numbers. You can transfer or withdraw PF online on the member portal once your KYC (Aadhaar, PAN, bank) is linked.

items.q: What is the notice period for employees?
also: resign karne pe notice period kitna hai
items.a: Notice period (edit to match your company): 30 days during probation and 60 days after confirmation, unless the offer letter says otherwise. Submit your resignation by email to your manager and HR. Notice can be shortened by manager approval or adjusted against leave balance / salary as per policy.

Probation is usually 3 to 6 months from joining (as per your offer letter). At the end, the manager reviews performance and HR issues a confirmation letter; probation can be extended if needed. Some benefits (such as certain leaves) may start after confirmation.

items.q: What is full and final settlement?
items.a: Full and final (F&F) settlement is the last payment after you leave: pending salary, leave encashment (as per policy), bonus / incentives due, minus any recoveries (notice shortfall, advances, unreturned assets). It is usually processed within 30 to 45 days of the last working day after asset return and clearances. You will also get a relieving letter and experience letter.

items.q: What is the work from home policy?

items.a: Work-from-home policy (edit to match your company): WFH is allowed with prior approval from the reporting manager, for a limited number of days per month, as per role. During WFH you must be available on calls and chat during office hours and log your attendance in the system.

items.q: What is the code of conduct?
items.a: Code of conduct highlights: treat everyone with respect; zero tolerance for harassment and discrimination; protect company and client confidential data; no conflict of interest (no side work for competitors or clients without approval); honest reporting of time and expenses; follow IT and data security rules; and report concerns to HR or your manager. Violations can lead to disciplinary action.

Harassment can be reported to the Internal Committee (IC / ICC) under the POSH Act, to HR, or to any senior manager, in writing or by email. Complaints are handled confidentially and without retaliation. The committee will investigate and act within the legal timelines. In an emergency, contact local authorities.

items.q: How to claim reimbursement for expenses?
items.a: Submit expense claims in the HR / expense system (or the expense form) with original bills or receipts within 30 days of the expense, along with manager approval. Approved claims are usually paid with the next salary cycle. Keep all bills; claims without valid bills may be rejected.

Appraisals (edit to match your company) happen once a year, usually in April, based on goals / KPIs, manager feedback and company performance. Some roles have a mid-year review. Increments and promotions are communicated after the review cycle.

items.q: What is the difference between an offer letter and an appointment letter?
also: offer letter aur appointment letter me fark
items.a: An offer letter is issued before joining with the role, CTC, joining date and key terms, which the candidate accepts. An appointment letter is issued on or after joining and contains the detailed terms of employment: designation, salary breakup, probation, notice period, policies, confidentiality and other conditions.
